_comment: Armorsmithing Bench recipes. Tier-unlocked medium and heavy armor crafted from cured pelts, iron, steel, and alloys.

recipes.name: Leather Armor
recipes.description: Craft a sturdy chestpiece from stitched wolf pelts.

recipes.name: Voidforged Greathelm
recipes.description: Hammer dense void plate into an impenetrable greathelm that deflects mortal blows.

recipes.name: Voidforged Plate Armor
recipes.description: Forge an impenetrable heavy void cuirass radiating otherworldly defensive power.

recipes.name: Reinforced Leather Helm
recipes.description: Reinforce a leather cap with shaved bone plates for increased defense.

recipes.name: Iron Greathelm
recipes.description: Hammer raw iron ore and bone into a sturdy full-coverage greathelm.

recipes.name: Iron Plate Armor
recipes.description: Forge thick iron plates fitted over timber framing and bone rivets.

recipes.name: Studded Leather Helm
recipes.description: Fashion a resilient combat helm from orc hide studded with salvaged steel.

recipes.name: Studded Leather Armor
recipes.description: Craft an impenetrable vest of thick orc hide heavily studded with steel.

recipes.name: Steel Greathelm
recipes.description: Forge a heavy steel greathelm incorporating orc leather padding.

recipes.name: Steel Plate Armor
recipes.description: Forge a masterwork suit of articulated steel plate backed by heavy orc hide.

recipes.name: Rimehide Helm
recipes.description: Shape cured pelts and dense orc hide into a protective medium helm.

recipes.name: Rimehide Armor
recipes.description: Stitch tough orc hide and glacial essence into a resilient medium cuirass.

recipes.name: Rimeforged Greathelm
recipes.description: Forge a heavy steel greathelm chilled with sub-zero glacial essence.

recipes.name: Rimeforged Plate
recipes.description: Forge a pinnacle suit of heavy armor mounted with the Sovereign's rime carapace.

recipes.name: Ossuary Plate
recipes.description: Heavy iron cuirass reinforced with interlocking skeletal plates from the deep ossuary.

recipes.name: Cinderguard Helm
recipes.description: Heavy void-plate helm tempered in volcanic ash to withstand searing blasts.

recipes.name: Yetihide Armor
recipes.description: Rugged leather cuirass lined with thick frost-beast hides for extreme protection.

recipes.name: Everwinter Plate
recipes.description: Impenetrable plate armor bound with rime carapaces and eternal permafrost.

recipes.name: Nomad's Coat
recipes.description: A reinforced traveling coat woven with frost-resistant linings and desert resilience.
